capabilities: search RAWG, Steam, and VNDB databases and create notes from results
edit personal playthrough stats, ratings, and reviews via a modal
refresh remote metadata while preserving custom frontmatter
manually catalog unlisted games and visual novels
organize notes into configurable subfolder patterns
extras: Steam and VNDB lookups work without an API key; only RAWG requires a free one. Beta testing via BRAT is documented. Listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The README does not state a motivation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull video game and visual novel metadata, cover art, and playtime info into notes or track personal playthrough stats.

relations.evidence: Banners Integration: Auto-populates banner: "url" and banner_y: 0.5 frontmatter properties.
100% standard YAML frontmatter serialization for Dataview use.

summary: Metadata fetcher that searches game and visual novel databases (RAWG, Steam, VNDB, HowLongToBeat) and creates catalog notes with artwork, stats, and Dataview-ready frontmatter.
